title: Disco-Bus envelope v0.5
description: Frozen contract for v0.5. Listeners reject any envelope with mesh_version != "0.5".

mesh_version.description: Frozen version string. Listeners must reject any other value with state=FAILED.

id.description: SQLite primary key. Assigned by dispatcher on acceptance. Absent on inbound /mesh/ping body.

tracking_id.description: Human-readable handle: msg-{id}-{YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS}. Assigned by dispatcher on acceptance.

from.description: Sender agent. Server-bound from MCP identity — caller cannot spoof.

to.description: Target agent. Must exist in the agents.json registry.

reply_to.description: Parent message id. Links replies to their prompt. Null/absent for new pings.

subject.description: Short label, free-form. Convention: kebab-case, under 80 chars.

body.description: Free-form JSON payload. Schema is sender's choice.

state.description: Lifecycle state. On the wire (delivered to a listener) only SENT ever appears; DELIVERED/FAILED are recorded outcomes. HELD and DROPPED (dispatcher pause, v0.8) are dispatcher-internal and appear only on query surfaces (state/history/thread/held) — never in a delivered envelope, never in an inbox view.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of dispatcher acceptance.

delivered_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when listener returned 200. Null until delivered.

delivery_error.description: Error message if state=FAILED. Null otherwise.

read_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the recipient first fetched the message through ping_read. Null until read.
